summary: Backend and full-stack delivery across two enterprise products — an accounts-finance platform and a seed-to-sale cultivation ERP.
intro: Full-stack delivery across two enterprise products for external clients: a finance platform for a large manufacturer, and a seed-to-sale cultivation ERP. Both are closed-source client work, so the write-up below describes the engineering without naming the clients or the products.

products.name: Accounts-finance platform
products.stack: Django REST · React 19 + TypeScript · Redis · MySQL · Azure · SAP PI/PO · Docker
points: Own the **SAP ERP integration** and the **multi-step approval workflow**, from the Django data model up to the React 19 UI.

Built the integration client around the failure modes that actually cost money — **retries deliberately exclude POST**, because a retried post double-books an accounting document, and **SAP's HTTP-200 business errors** are detected rather than read as success.

Audit and hardening: an **append-only audit log** with a Redis write-behind buffer that can never block the operation it audits, a per-day dashboard cache, a **sliding-window rate limiter**, and the Azure AD SSO flow on the frontend.

products.name: Seed-to-sale cultivation ERP
products.stack: Django 4 · DRF · React 18 · MUI · MySQL · Redis · Highcharts · AWS S3 · Metrc API
points: Rebuilt the **Metrc compliance layer** — the state-mandated seed-to-sale system operators report to — as a declarative registry of **57 endpoint configurations**, with failure handling for the HTTP 200 and empty body Metrc returns on some successful writes, which a naive parse reports as a failed sync.

**Two-way sync** across plants, harvests, packages, lab-test lots and personnel, plus a crop-plan and routine engine rewrite, a read-authorization gap closed in DRF's default permission map, and **IoT device integration modelled as data** so onboarding a new device is a row insert rather than a deploy.

summary: Shipped client-requested features on a MERN real-estate platform under a TDD workflow.
intro: A two-month internship on a MERN-stack real-estate platform.
points: Delivered **3 client-requested features** — advanced property search filters, interactive location maps, and saved searches — at a 95% passing rate during testing.
Worked **test-first with Jest**, which cut deployment-phase bugs by around 15%.
